dialogues.speaker: Zhonglin
dialogues.text: My business? I'm just a small-time vendor. I pick up the few little bits of business that slip through the hands of those Liyue tycoons, the Qixing.

dialogues.speaker: Zhonglin
dialogues.text: As a traveling merchant, you can't possibly make good money from selling general goods you'd find in a store. You have to focus on more niche items.

dialogues.speaker: Zhonglin
dialogues.text: These mushrooms are from Sumeru, for example. I'll bet you've never seen them before.
